benchmark.name: AbFlow (KDD 2026), 60-case RAbD aggregate
benchmark.note: 60-case aggregate, not 5BV7-specific; paper has RMSD-definition discrepancy (Sec 5.2 vs App C)

our_results.protocol: ProteinMPNN design (20 variants) + Boltz2 structure (top 3); align on antibody framework C-alpha (B all + C minus CDR-H3); CDR-H3 C-alpha metrics

comparison: MIXED - AAR better (our best 0.4737 vs benchmark mean 0.4234); structural reconstruction worse (our best RMSD 6.46 A vs Table 2 1.83 A; TM-score 0 vs 0.97). Single case vs 60-case aggregate.
integrity: TM-score 0 is correct for the large CDR-H3 displacements (short loops are TM-sensitive). Did not resolve the paper's RMSD-definition discrepancy; reported Table 1 and Table 2 separately.
